description: Cycling Routes Way-Finding Map is a dataset listed in Lake Macquarie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Lake Macquarie City Council. Drawing on community feedback, we have developed a cycling way-finding map to help people move more safely about the city until such time links in the cycling network are constructed. The map will be updated periodically. Coverage: Lake Macquarie, New South Wales. The portal files it under Infrastructure and Communications. Its keywords are Cycling, Pedestrian, Wayfinding, Planning, Pathways, Cycleways. The portal shows 1,686 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lakemac-com-au-portal.
